base_protocol.arrival_model: independent Poisson arrivals per second; common tape across budgets
base_protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames; released jobs only; FIFO within class
base_protocol.score: queue weighted actual frame departures divided by actual frame duration
base_protocol.budget_unit: candidate construction or feasibility attempt; seeds included
base_protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at horizon, then drain the same finite prefix

changed_rule: when initial challenger and incumbent have the same physical action, release the four reserved attempts and continue the same search frontier to total K
fallback: after recovery choose the final support incumbent; newly found unrolled challengers cannot compete

unchanged_rollout.allocation: reserve four attempts if K covers current homogeneous seeds plus four; otherwise current K and return support incumbent
unchanged_rollout.contenders: current paid support incumbent and old analytic J minimizer; identical physical actions skip rollout; no unpriced candidates compete
unchanged_rollout.support_floor: max(current homogeneous seed support, 0.99*current paid incumbent), not the full-K incumbent
unchanged_rollout.terminal: V2(r)=two no-new-arrival executable frame holding areas plus Vfluid(r_after2); r=Q-D
unchanged_rollout.successor: choose nonempty class maximizing q_i/mu_i; choose largest fitting measured pure-class batch; maximal identical lane copies, remaining lanes idle
unchanged_rollout.ties: class index; same batch shortest duration then option index; final objective then higher support, shorter duration and lexical indices
unchanged_rollout.successor_budget: one directly constructed and verified full frame per step; both contenders receive exactly two steps, including paid idle when empty
unchanged_rollout.work_accounting: total attempts=current+successor; catalogue/index probes, class scans, completion reads and fluid value coordinates also reported
unchanged_rollout.arrival_input: same registered Poisson rates through window and drain; new-arrival interaction with discrete batches remains in the old fluid correction
unchanged_rollout.controls: v4 and analytic lookahead at full K; analytic lookahead at the identical reduced current budget isolates search allocation
unchanged_rollout.reference: v4 at K120 is the exact support reference; a rollout selector at K120 need not select the exact-support action
unchanged_rollout.stopping_rule: one fixed 144-run development roster; no depth, priority or budget tuning after outcomes

search_state: keep paid seeds, bounds, frontier, incumbent and candidate pool; never restart or repay earlier attempts
pricing: cache candidate costs by object identity; count actual evaluations, including initially eligible candidates later excluded by the final floor
certificates: upper bound, incumbent and 1% eligibility use the final current pool; total attempts=current+successors<=K
natural_completion: no extra attempts when the current search is already complete
known_counterexample: the previous active-rollout state (1,4,8) must preserve every old selection field; this step does not revise the terminal model
reference: v4 K120 remains the exact support reference
stopping_rule: all 144 cases once; no change to the terminal rule or budget policy after outcomes
